title: Polish-Style Sauerkraut Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with sauerkraut, beef, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Brown the beef cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, allspice, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sauerkraut, beef broth, and browned beef.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
